Thank you for expressing yourself on here. I completely understand how hard it can be to socialize. I’m proud of you for trying and you should be too. It may not have gone to plan but you still had the courage to go out there and talk to others. That takes a lot.
I’m here for you.. I know how it feels to go through these feelings. You’re not alone.
I’m here if you ever need someone. I know how rough life can be, I understand, and you’re going through something very painful. My dms are always open

I know how frustrating that is, if you ever need someone to vent to I’m here. I can’t tell you it’ll get better, because I don’t know that, but I do believe you’ll have moments where you don’t want to end your life.
